title: AnimationPlayer > StateMachine > Transitions with SwitchMode Immediate are ignored if current animation has another transition with SwitchMode AtEnd
body: ### Tested versions tested in v4.3.stable and v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6] ### System information Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+ and Compatibility) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7602) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) ### Issue description When two transitions from a single animation in an animation StateMachine are available but only one of them has SwitchMode set to AtEnd, the animationPlayer will sometimes wait for the animation to finish playing and take that transition even though the other transition is available right now. Whether it chooses to do this or not seems to be influenced by what order the transition were made in. For example; in this screenshot new_animation is playing until the end because the transition to new_animation 2 was made more recently and has the SwitchMode set to AtEnd. The animtree is ignoring the transition to RESET even though its SwitchMode is immediate. ### Steps to reproduce Create an animation state machine structured like so: None of these transitions have any requirements. The animation in the middle is a 5 second animation, the others are just the RESET state. When the animation is playing it will rapidly switch back and forth between the middle node and one of the side nodes. #### The Problem If you select the transition it's using to rapidly switch from that side node to the middle node and set the SwitchMode to AtEnd, the state machine will wait until the animation finishes playing to switch to that same side node, even though the other transition is available right now with SwitchMode immediate. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [reproductionproject.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21240911/reproductionproject.zip) ### Workaround Make sure any transition from an animation that have SwitchMode set to AtEnd are made FIRST, and them make any transitions that have SwitchMode set to Immediate afterward.
